Source: https://github.com/googlecreativelab/access-mars
Pinned commit: 4b0a445f4e3b3fbfbc6b06f3adf07c24c05a2c57
Terrain and photographs: NASA/JPL-Caltech and Google Creative Lab.

Modified for Beacon: Draco decoded offline; original scene scale preserved;
coordinate handedness, triangle winding and original shader UV correction applied;
geometry repacked for Unity. Original JPEG files are unchanged; their in-app
textures are compressed for Quest. Added native rendering, walking collision,
distance haze and a visual orientation to the mission ring. This orientation is
reference scenery, not a georegistration to the mission route. No endorsement is implied.

Beacon 0.10 adds a separate AI-generated illustrative surface texture in its
shader: neutral grey photography receives warm cosmetic fill and nearby
surfaces receive fine detail. This is not NASA imagery or recovered survey data.
Original photographs, mesh vertices, collision and mission data are unchanged.
